reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-05 allocates pattern_info nodes with owned text/compiled fields and allocates highlight storage blocks containing node arrays. Global filter/tree anchors retain the published owners.
owner_creation.invariant: Pattern and highlight allocations need distinct owner roots.
limitations: Native compiled internals are delegated to the pattern module.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-05 matches_filters retains a filter node while lending its compiled/text fields and converted line to match_pattern, then reads the successor after return.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A filter node must outlive the native-match borrow and successor read.
limitations: The local raw pointer carries no exclusion against handler retirement.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-05 can be entered from u_interrupt: the handler calls set_filter_pattern(NULL,0), whose null branch clears compiled/text owners and frees every filter node.
callback_targets.invariant: Filter retirement must not run inside an interrupting handler.
limitations: M0-SIG-001 remains a source-traced asynchronous lifetime concern.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-05 clr_hlist frees node arrays and storage records before nulling all tree aliases and preparation bounds. set_filter_pattern also invalidates the whole old filter chain on clear.
invalidation.invariant: No old tree or filter alias survives its clear operation.
limitations: Nulling roots afterward cannot revoke an already suspended raw alias.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-05 compiles a new filter before linking it to filter_infos, with explicit pre/post-commit injection points. set_pattern first un-compiles an existing compiled field, so replacement is not uniformly transactional.
mutation_commit.invariant: Commit boundaries must identify old and staged owner lifetimes.
limitations: Pre-commit staging of a fresh node does not approve every existing-pattern update.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-05 clear_pattern frees text and un-compiles native state; clearing filters then frees outer nodes. A successful matches_filters branch also consumes cline and chpos before returning true.
release_pair.invariant: Callers must not release converted buffers again after a consuming match.
limitations: False-match paths leave those buffers for the enclosing caller.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-05 failed fresh filter compilation frees its outer candidate; the before-commit hook explicitly clears candidate pattern fields before free. These local exits do not protect owners interrupted by SIGINT.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error cleanup must follow whether the candidate has been published.
limitations: No failure-injection campaign is rerun by this source review.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-05 leaves M0-SIG-001 open: u_interrupt replaces filter state directly while matches_filters can retain a node across match_pattern and successor access. There is no deferred owner-retirement handoff in these paths.
signals_handoff.invariant: Handler notifications must precede ordinary-loop filter mutation.
limitations: This packet records the route without claiming a reproduced failure.

src/signal.rs.relationship: u_interrupt at src/signal.rs:44-56 calls set_filter_pattern(NULL,0), entering the filter/tree retirement analyzed by OWN-05 while ordinary search may retain a filter node.
